data.summary: Kabelnetz Beispielstadt GmbH informs Bastian Musterquell that the monthly price of his "Kabel 250" internet tariff rises from €34.99 to €37.99, effective 1 February 2027. Because the change is not only beneficial to him, he has a special right to cancel the contract free of charge within three months of receiving this letter.
data.explanation: Your internet provider is raising your monthly fee by €3.00. Because a price increase is not purely in your favour, German law gives you a special right to end the contract early, free of charge and without the usual notice period, if you do so within the stated period after receiving this letter — the app will show you until when. You don't have to do anything if you're happy to keep the contract at the new price; it will simply continue and the higher amount will be charged from the effective date shown. If you'd rather switch provider, you can use this window to cancel instead of waiting for the normal notice period.
